title: Fish Lake Outfitters
specs: Each adult (12 and older) must have a Utah Fishing license
Maximum combined weight 940 pounds for up to 4 anglers
Accommodates up to 4 anglers per trip
includes: Essential fishing gear (rods, bait, tackle) included
Fish cleaning of your catch free if you keep fish
blurb: Guests join guided fishing trips on Fish Lake with a professional guide providing essential fishing gear. Trips target species of the guest's choosing. Fish cleaning is offered free if guests keep their catch, with fish over 24" required to be released.
extraNote: Trips are non-refundable but may be rescheduled at least 15 days prior · Trips canceled by operator due to unsafe weather or other issues will be rescheduled · Participants must sign a liability waiver before departure · Life jackets and safety equipment must be worn when required · Alcohol or drug use during trips is prohibited
